output.objection: You are treating my request as a free upgrade, but I am asking you to acknowledge that the manual hand-over is a known gap. I will only accept automation if it relies on tools we already pay for.
output.correction: I am not negotiating a new budget or asking for a different pipeline architecture. I am simply setting a condition on the automation work you are proposing for the versioning step.
